title: xdrip on oneplus 5 with ticwatch pro
symptom: Standalone mode stopped working; after reinstalling, only NFC works. Log shows continual 'got null pointer trying to set cccd descriptor'. Miaomiao connects but disconnects after minutes, requiring manual restart.
evidence_quote: lately i tried using stand alone, didnt work anymore, tried few things unistalled reinstalled, now nothing works except NFC. looking in the log i get continual "got null pointer trying to set cccd descriptor". miao manages to get connected but shortly after (minutes), its noted as "not connected".
